blocks.text: You can configure the browser end user notification (EUN) templates with custom block and custom caution messages. To display the EUNs on the browser when the Cloud App Control Policy, URL Filtering rule, or File Type Control rule with block or caution action is triggered, you must reference one of the templates created here in the Cloud App Control Policy, URL Filtering rule, and File Type Control rule. To learn more, see Configuring the URL Filtering Policy, Adding Rules to the Cloud App Control Policy, and Configuring the File Type Control Policy.
Browser EUN templates provide the following benefits and allow you to:

blocks.item: Configure custom messages in addition to modifying default messages for the block and caution actions on a per policy rule basis.
Associate the EUN templates with the Cloud App Control policy, URL Filtering rules, and File Type Control rule.

blocks.text: Zscaler EUNs come with default notification messages for each policy type, which can be customized. You can customize various elements of the notification, including the notification message for different policy actions, company name, logo, information displayed on the notification, duration of the notification, and more.
On the EUN Templates page (Administration > End User Notification > End User Notifications > EUN Templates), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add a custom message for an EUN template.
Modify the table and its columns.
Select to show or hide the Channel filter available for this page.
Filter the template list by a specific policy type. The All option displays the templates configured for all the policy types.
View a list of all EUN templates that were configured for your organization. For each template, you can see the following:
Name: The name of the EUN template. You can sort this column.
Channel: The policy type (Cloud App Control, URL Filtering, or File Type Control) for which the custom message is added. You can sort this column.
Edit or delete an EUN template.
The EUN templates are paginated with up to 500 templates displayed per page.
Go to the Global EUN Configuration tab.
Go to the Client Connector tab.
